name: Stay! Stay! Democratic People's Republic of Korea!
source:
The year is 2016, America is back in Afghanistan, and you, soldier, are about to get a well deserved vacation. What better way to spend it than with some of your Korean Army pen-pals, Jeong and Eunji? "Pyongyang" is just a suburb of Seoul, right? Unfortunately not. Welcome to North Korea. Enjoy your stay.

Try and navigate your way through one of the world's most tightly controlled dictatorships, with two cute soldiers by your side. Avoid getting shot, executed, black-bagged, or tried for treason as you explore Pyongyang's most famous tourist attractions.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1930242464/go-go-democratic-peoples-republic-of-korea/]Kickstarter campaign[/url]]
translation:
2016年，美国重返阿富汗，而你，士兵，即将享受一个应得的假期。还有什么比和韩国陆军笔友Jeong和Eunji一起度过更好的方式呢？“平壤”只是首尔的郊区，对吗？不幸的是没有。欢迎来到朝鲜。祝你住宿愉快。

尝试在世界上控制最严格的独裁国家之一中前行，并有两名可爱的士兵在你身边。当你探索平壤最著名的旅游景点时，请避免被枪杀、处决、黑包或因叛国罪受审。

[来自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1930242464/go-go-democratic-peoples-republic-of-korea/]Kickstarter活动[/url]]
